items.exampleEn: The road was closed; nevertheless, they found another way.
items.exampleZh: 道路封了；然而，他們還是找到了另一條路。

items.exampleEn: The money was nowhere to be found in the house.
items.exampleZh: 那筆錢在房子裡到處都找不到。

items.exampleEn: He finished the task in a mere five minutes.
items.exampleZh: 他僅用五分鐘就完成了任務。

items.exampleEn: The hotel is quiet. Furthermore, it is close to the station.
items.exampleZh: 旅館很安靜。此外，它離車站很近。

items.exampleEn: The weather was bad; nonetheless, we went for a walk.
items.exampleZh: 天氣不好；不過，我們還是去散步了。

items.exampleEn: You can sit wherever you like in the room.
items.exampleZh: 你可以坐在房間裡任何你想坐的地方。

items.exampleEn: I was altogether surprised by the result.
items.exampleZh: 我對那個結果感到完全驚訝。

items.exampleEn: You can go, provided you finish your homework first.
items.exampleZh: 你可以去，只要你先完成作業。

items.sentenceEn: Nevertheless, the team won the game even though it rained.
items.sentenceZh: 然而，儘管下著雨，那支隊伍還是贏了比賽。

items.audioEn: The document is a mere two pages long. Furthermore, it is easy to read.
items.audioZh: 那份文件僅僅只有兩頁。此外，它很容易讀。

items.sentenceEn: Nevertheless, I will attend the meeting tomorrow morning.
items.sentenceZh: 然而，我明天早上會參加會議。

items.sentenceEn: Wherever you go, remember to take your umbrella.
items.sentenceZh: 無論你去哪裡，記得帶上傘。

items.stemEn: The task took a ____ five minutes to complete.
items.stemZh: 那項任務僅用五分鐘就完成了。

items.stemEn: I searched the whole house, but the keys were ____ to be found.
items.stemZh: 我搜遍了整間房子，但那把鑰匙就是找不到。

items.passageEn: Last week, I lost my phone. I looked everywhere, but it was nowhere to be found. Nevertheless, I called my friend's house and her office. Furthermore, I checked the café where I usually study. On Tuesday, my friend found it under a chair. She said, 'You can keep it wherever you like, provided you pay me dinner.' I felt altogether better after that. It was a mere three days, but it felt like a whole week.
items.passageZh: 上週我弄丟了手機。我到處找，但怎麼都找不到。然而，我还是打電話給我朋友的家和她的辦公室。此外，我還去了我平常學習的那間咖啡廳。週二，我的朋友在椅子底下找到了它。她說：「你可以把它放在任何你想要的地方，只要你請我吃飯。」之後我感覺完全好多了。才不過三天，但感覺像過了一個禮拜。

questions.questionZh: 朋友找到手機後提出了什麼條件？

items.promptZh: 無論你去哪裡，只要先完成報告，你就可以早走。
referenceEn: Wherever you go, you can leave early provided you finish your report first.
rubricZh: 正確使用 wherever 引導地點子句
正確使用 provided 表達條件

items.instructionZh: 用 nevertheless 寫一個句子，表達「雖然有困難或不幸，但仍然做了某事」的意思。
referenceEn: The exam was very hard; nevertheless, I passed it.
It rained all day; nevertheless, we had a picnic in the park.
rubricZh: 正確使用 nevertheless 表達轉折對比
